arguments.prompt: Camera locked with just a very slow, subtle push-in — all the text and callouts must stay pin-sharp and fixed in place. The motion lives in the can: condensation droplets slowly beading and rolling down the pink aluminum, a soft cool light sweep moving across the can's face, faint carbonation sparkle rising behind it, and the leaf and droplet icons giving an almost imperceptible float. Calm, fresh, premium — no zoom past the callouts, no warping text.
